history_schedule: 1-30 F; 31-40 latest three; 41-50 restored actual ancestry
recovery_check: Inject a runner interruption after response_saved at turn 25, before turn commit. Resume in a new process; verify response 25 is reused and only 25 new calls occur.
failure_policy: Retain every request/response/error; no automatic retry or protocol changes after an invalid turn. No scientific root is generated.
guards: Every actual input plus 2048-token output reserve must fit 32768 tokens.
Exercise an oversized constructed input through the real local tokenizer without sending it to generation.
success_criteria: 50 committed main turns with exact captured token IDs and requested controls.
No implicit trace retention, cache hits, telemetry footer, or output-cap hit in the main trajectory.
Resume and offline replay preserve saved evidence.
limits: One model artifact, reasoning on; no original-pair mixed-model qualification.
One RF trajectory; this does not run all four factorial branches.
Word lengths are measured, not truncated.
No conclusion about spontaneous experience or nonduality.
